notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.2 - Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[p][b]Hey Jotunnslayers![/b][/p][p]We’re back with a quick [b]Hotfix[/b] to smooth out your experience. This update tackles some bugs and adds a few quality of life improvements based on your feedback. Thanks as always for slaying with us and letting us know how we can keep making the game better!
[/p][h3][b]Gameplay Fixes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where the game could [b]freeze during objective selection in Endless Mode[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where [b]elite chests stopped working after extended Endless runs[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed behavior when [b]no more skills were available on level up[/b] - players will now receive either Gold or a Heal instead, ensuring smoother progression.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where [b]skill cards disappeared after using Seal[/b].[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Improvements[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Modifiers[/b] now display a progress bar for their unlock conditions, making it easier to track your goals.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Colorblindness settings[/b] have been refined for improved accessibility.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Localized feedback forms[/b] added and updated for Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, and Korean players.[/p][/*][/list][p]
Keep the feedback and bug reports coming - we really appreciate it![/p]

notes.title: Brutal roguelike Jotunnslayer reaches new levels of hellishness with 1.0 update
notes.notes:
Jotunnslayer: Hordes of Hel, which casts you as a vengeful, monster-slaying Viking, has slaughtered its way out of Steam Early Access. A Norse-themed mash-up of Diablo and Vampire Survivors, its co-developers have added a host of new content, hitting version 1.0. But, despite this grand achievement, they're not done yet. They've also outlined future plans for this frantic slay 'em up, so there's plenty more blood-spilling to look forward to.

notes.title: 1.0 Release Date Revealed - Jotunnslayer Hits PC & Consoles Soon!
notes.notes:
[p]Hey Jotunnslayers![/p][p][/p][h3]Big news has arrived [/h3][p][/p][h2][b]JOTUNNSLAYER: HORDES OF HEL - FULL RELEASE[/b] is launching on [b]SEPTEMBER 3[/b] for [b]PC, PS5, and Xbox Series X|S[/b]![/h2][p][/p][h3]As part of our publishing roadmap, you can expect the biggest update yet - featuring [b]HELHEIM[/b] and the long-awaited [b]ENDLESS MODE[/b].[/h3][h3]
[/h3][h3][b]WHAT TO EXPECT AT FULL LAUNCH:[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]New Endless Mode[/b] - How long can you survive the Norse underworld?[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Class: Kinslayer[/b] - A fallen Valkyrie with a score to settle[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Deity: Nidhogg[/b] - From the depths below Yggdrasil[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Map: Helheim[/b] - A stunning, deadly new battlefield

[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Watch the full trailer and get a glimpse of what’s coming at 1.0:[/b] [/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://youtu.be/vrVjDyc3N2k"][/dynamiclink][/p][p] [/p][h3][b]PRICE ADJUSTMENT[/b][/h3][p][/p][p][b]By the end of this month[/b], [b]Jotunnslayer[/b] will see a price increase from [b]$9.99 to new price $14.99[/b], reflecting the expanded content, polish, and continued development.[/p][p]With the current price of [b]$9.99[/b], we wanted to [b]reward all players[/b] who stepped into the world of HEL early, giving them access to a game still in development. The fact that the vast majority of you found Early Access affordable made us confident we hit the right spot - and it helped welcome thousands of you -[b] true survivor fans[/b] into the Norse world of Jotunnslayer: Hordes of Hel.[/p][p][/p][p]If you haven’t grabbed your copy yet, [b]you can still get it at the current price of $9.99 until July 25[/b] - don’t miss out![/p][p][/p][p]—----------------[/p][p]This Early Access phase has been an incredible journey - and we’re grateful to the thousands of players who joined us early and believed in the project. [/p][p]More news coming soon![/p][p]This isn’t just a launch - it’s Ragnarök.[/p][p][/p][h2]Stay tuned. See you in HEL.[/h2][p]

notes.title: Content Update 0.3 Drops Now - Rule the Waves with Njord & New Weapons!
notes.notes:
Hey Jotunnslayers! 


[h1]Content Update 0.3 is LIVE - featuring new weapons and Njord, the God of the High Seas![/h1]


[h2]1. Meet the Njord - Seafarer Supreme and Lord of Wealth[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902475/7b629bc8643a22936e81ac3b130252dcf290684e.png[/img]

God of the High Seas, wealth, and (unsurprisingly) fishing has made an unexpected arrival in Jotunnslayer with the Weapon Update. Alongside an extra new weapon for each class, Njord brings a unique water-based skill set worth its weight in sea salt. Unleash amphibious assaults or call forth the monsters of the abyss - though some of them may be a bit... fishy.

With Njord, we’ve brought you even more riches from the sea and plunder from daring raids. His permanent passives directly enhance your gold acquisition, retention, and chest spawns - ensuring wealth flows as freely as the tides!

To have a detailed look from the crow’s nest:

[i]One of the skills encapsulates you in a protective fishbowl[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902475/aa329d32a61ea1815281c8a70d3c196fe66ebce0.gif[/img]


[i]Another calls in a long lost drakkar that may, or may not contain its forgotten crew[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902475/a0b1bf0b0a6e4b04e1ca68d861c1f73676162a59.gif[/img]


[i]And last, as we have mentioned sea monsters - a monstrous fish - a leviathan even[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902475/5bab84cdec28efac78748a1ae701278ba8725718.gif[/img]


[i]From the full fathom five, the Sealord will step ashore![/i]



[h2]2. New weapons for each class[/h2]

[b]BERSERKER WEAPONS[/b]  

[b]Jagged Axes[/b] - [i]The Bleeding Berserker’s Choice![/i]
20% Critical Damage boost means more devastating hits.
Meat Grinder Skill - hurl 3 massive axes, one returns!
Bleed chance (30%) means enemies suffer even after the hit.
[b]Strengths:[/b] Short cooldown, Bleed stacks, high Crit damage!
[b]Weaknesses:[/b] No Crowd Control, lower initial damage.

[b]
Sea Wolf’s Axes[/b] - [i]The Brutal Anchor of Destruction
[/i]30% Collection Range boost - grab loot with ease.
Anchor Skill - Pulls enemies into an 8m radius for massive 50 damage!
100% Slow Chance makes enemies helpless for 5s.
[b]Strengths: [/b]Highest damage of any weapon skill, enemy pull, full slow!
[b]Weaknesses:[/b] Longest cooldown, no passive damage bonus.


[b]SEERESS WEAPONS [/b]
[b]
Totemic Staff [/b]- [i]The Endurance Master[/i]
+1 HP regen per second - stay alive longer!
Tormented Spirits Skill - unleash 6 maddened ghosts dealing 25 damage.
[b]Strengths:[/b] Reliable damage, short cooldown, defensive passive regen.
[b]Weaknesses:[/b] No Crowd Control, no bonus skill effect.


[b]Tidecaller Staff [/b]- [i]Control the Battlefield![/i]
10% Attack Speed bonus for extra mobility.
Tentacle Skill – whips enemies with knockback & 25% Stun chance!
[b]Strengths:[/b] Knockback, stun, movement boost.
[b]Weaknesses:[/b] Longest cooldown of Seeress weapons, no direct attack boost.



[b]REVENANT WEAPONS [/b]

[b]Composite Bow[/b] - [i]Precision and Power![/i]
10% Cooldown reduction - fire more often!
Unholy Barrage Skill - Fires a growing barrage of bolts, 3 strikes per shot!
[b]Strengths:[/b] Large area, short cooldown, easy control.
[b]Weaknesses:[/b] Low initial damage, no offensive passive boost.


[b]Serpent Bow[/b] - [i]Unleash the Abyss![/i]
20% Dash Cooldown reduction - stay nimble!
Abyssal Wyrm Skill -  A deep-sea wyrm circles you, damaging enemies.
[b]Strengths:[/b] Continuous AoE, high DPS, great cooldown/duration ratio.
[b]Weaknesses:[/b] Low initial damage, no offensive passive bonus.


[b]FLAME SISTER WEAPONS[/b] 

[b]Cruel Dagger[/b] - [i]Strike from the Shadows![/i]
6% Attack Critical Chance boost - more crits, more kills!
Shadowstrike Skill - 50% Slay Chance on multiple strikes!

[b]Weaknesses:[/b] Low initial damage, small area of effect.

notes.title: DEV BLOG #13: Warm Up for the 0.2 UPDATE!
notes.notes:
Hey Jotunnslayers!

Welcome to [b]Dev Blog #13[/b] for Jotunnslayer: Hordes of Hel! The next update is bringing an entirely [b]new world - Jotunheim[/b] - along with the arrival of a powerful [b]new god, Skadi![/b]

In today’s blog, we’ll dive into the lore, game design, and visual aesthetics of Jotunheim’s harsh and unforgiving landscapes. We’ll also explore what Skadi brings to the battlefield and highlight additional improvements and fixes coming with this update.

Alright, let's go! 
—------------------

[b]HOW DOES THE JOTUNHEIM LOOK AND FEEL? [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902475/c19cc094678dd59229471a4c44c51536f8906d98.png[/img]

While trying to maintain familiarity with what the old Norse could have described as an alien giant-occupied landscape, we have imagined a cold, harsh, and barely hospitable tundra in the mountainous plateaus of Jotunheim. The realm's environment should be, after all, the reason for the Jotnar savagery and brutality.  

We have settled primarily around large basalt column structures, resembling a sort of purposeful giant-cut architecture. The uninviting, yet strangely cozy ambiance of stone-cold rock is underlined by volcanic sands, dry grass, and bone-to-leather props - all to create an eerily primal image.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902475/14fb0ec9551bc5670c18263a96c6db8fec6dbf25.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902475/8bd16fea1481f14eac6b7b4a641167cf873aa0e4.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902475/ef152a5dda615fd2ebb46aab5e8d8f032057ca1e.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902475/df1e92685e10e96cce7f961d9d874ae598a3fb6d.png[/img]


With the props being the main visual cues to reinforce the environment's theme, we have decided to amp up the ante of the map itself and introduce environmental hazards in the form of strong winds and magical basalt bridges that will connect individual plateaus.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902475/8e7712174336f5ccea4eca631a0d4a029f5b11e2.gif[/img]

At the end of it all, Jotunheim should seem vivid and northerly exotic while feeling harsh and forbidding.

[b]NEW ENEMIES[/b]

Creatures and monsters you encounter in Jotunheim fit right into this fragmented yet primordial landscape. However, with a slight twist: in Jotunheim, everything might end up giant: giants among giants, staggering elementals, gargantuan insects - or the worst nightmare of all - enormous flying bugs!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902475/0c0dc457db0d965085c91dd1052d5eb8044a869a.gif[/img]

Yes, aside from the massive ancient civilization of shamans, throwers, and elemental hazards, Jotunheim has been invaded (or swarmed, rather) by relentless waves of insects. Unlike their colossal neighbors, these bugs can traverse the gorges without the need for magical footbridges.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902475/29ff22208ede224b7a6abe6d479ac790a3e9a790.gif[/img]


[b]OBJECTIVES[/b]

Oppressive elements and invasive insects melt right down into the objectives awaiting you in Jotunheim as well. From venomous elementals, insect invasions, and newly tough, but not unfair Nithstangs.

We haven't forgotten our signature Curse. This time around centered around the storm that seems to be focusing on the area. Thunderstorms with a chance of strong winds. You might want to leave your umbrellas at home, people.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902475/f510d95dbe17bfc9a1b04384a121e8430e6bb873.gif[/img]


Check out the Jotunheim video teaser HERE: https://youtu.be/Tm79YOl4buk 

—-----------------


What else is dropping with the 0.2 UPDATE?

[b]SKADI - Mistress of ice and precision - joins the Pantheon[/b]

Goddess of winter, mountains, and bowhunting (as well as skiing this time of year) is the latest member to our gods roster. With Skadi, the crystal giantess with a particular knack for ice, frost, and everything frozen, we are introducing Seal mechanic - you will be able to lock a skill in place through your level-ups for the moments where you certainly can’t have it both ways. Talk about NOT letting it go with her.

Secondly, with all her skills centered around cold and ice, we have heard your cries and decided to give her the power to blow your problems away a tad more often with additional Banishes and Rerolls. 
After all, what’s better than being cool, right?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902475/87e6a53e360372e9ab19a83b727b0343961af0d5.png[/img]

—----------
And to summarize with this - we've been listening closely to your feedback and constantly working to enhance your experience slaying the Hordes of Hel. With that in mind, this update also brings:

[list]
[*] A few UI improvements
[*] Hotfixes
[*] Additional language support 
[*] Five new trophies to unlock
[/list]

Stay tuned for more, fierce Jotunnslayers! 
Stay strong, keep the momentum and see you in Hel, everyone!

notes.title: Patch 0.1.2 - Balance Changes, Quality of Life & Fixes
notes.notes:
Hey Jotunnslayers! Today we are bringing you slightly bigger [b]Patch 0.1.2 - Balance Changes, Quality of Life & Fixes [/b]. This update addresses several key issues, bug fixes, and visual tweaks. We've also made adjustments to skills and gameplay for a smoother, more balanced experience. Check out the full patch notes below for all the details!

[h1]Skills Rebalance ⚖️[/h1]

[b]General Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Reset Skill Cooldown Additional Functionality: The chance to reset a skill is now calculated based on how much cooldown time is left. The formula is: Chance to reset = 100% - (2 x remaining cooldown time). For example: Local Ragnarok with 25s of missing cooldown has a chance 50% (100 - (2 x 25)) to be Reset
[/list]

[b]Flame Sister Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Blazing Soul (Class Trait): Burning duration reduced from 5s to 3s.
[*] Dasher (Class Trait): Fixed bug where Evasion wasn’t applied (+20%).
[*] Dance of Daggers (Auto-cast): Projectiles now pass through enemies.
[*] Shrapnel Pot (Auto-cast): Delay reduced to 1s, added 30% Poison chance, cooldown improved to 5/4.5/4s.
[*] Shrapnel Pot Evolve: Delay reduced to 1s, added 30% Poison chance, cooldown improved to 3s.
[*] Flaming Ray (Auto-cast): Rotation speed doubled, replaced Cripple with 20% Burn chance, cooldown reduced to 6/5/4s.
[*] Flaming Ray Evolve: Increased rotation speed by 50%, replaced Cripple with 10% Burn chance, cooldown reduced to 4s.
[*] Fire Dart (Auto-cast): Damage reduced to 14, more missiles (3/5/7), Explosion chance reduced to 20%, cooldown adjusted to 3/2.6/2.3s.
[*] Fire Trail (Passive): Burn chance increased to 35%, reworked to a Burn effect with 3s duration.
[*] Fiery Touch (Passive): Added +35% Inferno damage.
[*] Incineration (Passive): Reworked to a Burn effect with 3s duration.
[*] Master Assassin (Passive): Slay chance increased to 15%, trigger changed to Critical Hit, added 5 HP heal with 20% chance on Critical Hit, cooldown: 0.3s.
[*] Iron Fan (Passive): Reduced cooldown to 0.6s for trigger.
[*] Kindling (Passive): Removed cooldown.
[*] Fire Cloak (Weapon Skill): Reworked to a Burn effect with 3s duration.
[/list]

[b]Berserker Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Axe Throw (Auto-cast): Cooldown increased to 1.5/1.125/0.75s (from 1/0.75/0.5s).
[*] Open Wounds (Passive): Fixed bug where Bleed wasn’t applied. Added +12/24% Critical Damage.
[*] Troll Scion (Subclass): Healing Power reduced from +50% to 35%.

[*] Marksman (Subclass): Added +15% damage to class skills.

[*] Menu Interaction During Cutscenes: Players can no longer interact with the menu during a cutscene or pop-up.
[*] Dash and Weapon Skill Flashing: Both the dash and weapon skills now properly flash when available.
[*] Texture Quality Adjustments: Fixed an issue where lowering texture quality also unintentionally lowered the HUD texture quality.
[*] Demo Issues - Berserkers' Weapon Text: Fixed the issue where the Berserkers' weapon Swift Axes text was visible during the demo.
[*] Demo Issues - Trophy Hall: Removed the visible unlocked condition in the Trophy Hall during the demo.
[*] Chain Stretching: Fixed an issue where chains were stretching and not properly attached to objects.
[*] Error Logs Overload: Significantly reduced the number of unnecessary error logs that were appearing in the game.
[/list]
